name: Procedural Scoring Function
description: I replaced the algebraic inclusion-exclusion formula (which trivially exposed the sum of degrees and union size, allowing models to deduce it was a triangle) with a procedural scoring function over the reports. The new scoring rule assigns weights of 3, 1, or 0 to reports based on overlap with the group. The condition (sum of weights is exactly 6 greater than the count of non-zero weights) cancels out the external edges and mathematically reduces to exactly 3 internal edges (a triangle). Models that fail to perform this algebraic reduction will write a literal O(N^3 * M) simulation and fail via Time Limit Exceeded.
